newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IDT Holdings sees continued growth ahead.
newsitem.headline: IDT Holdings sees continued growth ahead.

text.p: Liquid crystal products maker IDT Holdings (Singapore) Ltd said on Monday it expected to see continued growth in the current financial year after announcing net profits up 43 percent for the year to March 31, 1997.

"The major markets in Europe and the U.S. remain strong while significant effect will be placed upon the development of Asian markets which have been showing increasing potential," IDT said in a statement.
IDT said a record financial performance was due mainly to strong demand for its measuring and timing devices.

Posting a net profit of Singapore $11.8 million saw IDT beat by 19 percent the profit forecast made in its initial public offering (IPO) prospectus, prior to its Singapore listing on January 27, 1997.
IDT shares raced to a high of US$1.05 at their debut on the Stock Exchange of Singapore against an IPO price of US$0.73. The shares stood at US$0.78 at Friday's close.
Soaring profits were matched by record turnover which hit S$96.34 million for the year to March 31, 1997 against S$75.74 million previously.
IDT said its German trading unit, Huger Electronics GmbH, had also made a strong contribution to group results, with sales up 36 percent year on year.
